description: Defines data structures and classes for Resource Element (RE) measurements in a wireless communication system, including dimensions, container interfaces, and various implementations (static and dynamic) for handling RE measurement data.

classes.name: re_measurement_dimensions
classes.description: Holds the dimensions of RE measurements: number of subcarriers, symbols, and slices.

classes.name: re_measurement
classes.description: Abstract interface for RE measurement containers, providing size, access, and resize methods.

classes.name: modular_re_measurement
classes.description: Template class for modular resource element measurements, allowing views and subsetting.

classes.name: re_measurement_tensor_base
classes.description: Base class template for tensor-based RE measurement containers, supporting set and get operations.

classes.name: static_re_measurement
classes.description: Fixed-size, compile-time allocated RE measurement container.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the dimensions of the RE measurement container.

methods.name: get_symbol
methods.description: Returns a span (view) over the specified symbol and slice.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the container to the specified dimensions.

methods.name: set_slice
methods.description: Sets data for a specific slice from a span.

methods.name: set_symbol
methods.description: Sets a view for a specific symbol and slice.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Copies data from another measurement object, with optional offset and subcarrier count.
